scope: prospective held-out workload and exact operation-family transfer pilot

primary.endpoint: best verified feasible whole-program speedup by measurement budget; cycle-reduction regret to complete measured pool

measurement_plan: Run the live agent first with a maximum of three sequential real candidate measurements. After it finalizes, measure every remaining candidate once to establish the 12-candidate oracle. Replay all prespecified non-agent policies using each policy’s own one-at-a-time observation prefix at budgets 1, 2, and 3. The physical dataset collection costs up to twelve candidate evaluations; replay prefixes do not erase that cost.

model_protocol.existing_pairwise_ranker: XGBRanker rank:pairwise, fixed 80 trees/depth 2/learning rate .05; historical labels only
model_protocol.factorized_model: existing 20-member feasibility XGBoost ensemble × public analytic cycle savings; seeds 0-4; not a speedup-magnitude model
model_protocol.active_learning: existing frozen Gaussian-process acquisition and paid-update controls; no tuning
model_protocol.heuristic_controls: frequency, merit, calibrated latency, random and the existing non-agent policies
model_protocol.uncertainty: all ensemble spreads/classifier scores remain uncalibrated; extrapolation support is diagnostic only

agent_protocol.scope: one prospective live Codex chat-relay episode with host-measured target observations
agent_protocol.model_label: current Codex chat model; exact deployment ID unavailable
agent_protocol.structured_action: one strict JSON object per response through the local bridge; host enforces identities, correctness, area, timing, and budget
agent_protocol.model_bundle: Seed-zero XGBRanker rank:pairwise trained on historical whole-program measured speedup orderings plus a 20-member XGBoost hardware-feasibility ensemble multiplied by public analytic cycle savings; all target workload labels and target operation families excluded.

ml_training.labels: historical measured whole-program speedup orderings and verified area/timing feasibility

agent_protocol.llm_training: No LLM fine-tuning. Prompt-based current Codex model receives structured candidate state, frozen ML predictions, public heuristics, hybrid retrieved approved historical examples, and only its own paid measurements.

memory.store: local TF-IDF / truncated-SVD historical memory; one measured record per chunk
memory.retrieval: lexical plus latent-semantic cosine fused by reciprocal-rank fusion
memory.knowledge_graph: typed graph support is available but is not queried in the frozen hybrid episode
memory.target_outcomes: never indexed or retrieved; only the agent own paid observations are returned

agent_protocol.human_in_loop: Human relay passes structured request/action between the active chat model and host. The host performs schema/candidate/budget checks and rejects unsafe measurements; no separate approval click is claimed.
agent_protocol.model_routing: This episode uses the current Codex chat relay. The Responses API provider supports bounded escalation when configured, but no cross-provider routing is used or evaluated here.
agent_protocol.stop_rule: Stop within three charged measurements; host finalizes the best paid verified feasible candidate or baseline.
